about: The Workbench's built-in insights: declared definitions run through plx.sql as the reader (operator_api/insights.py). No case, person or customer is named here.

insights.title: Work sent per person, last 28 days
insights.about: Per person: distinct non-bulk emails sent from their work address by sent date (the Mail sent measure, counted once across all mailboxes), Teams messages they posted and meetings they organised (not cancelled), over the last 28 days. Sorted by mail plus Teams, busiest first. Floor, lab and phone work is not seen, and mail sent from another address of theirs is not counted.
insights.sql:
WITH m AS (SELECT sender, count(DISTINCT message_id) AS n FROM emails
           WHERE sent_at >= now() - interval '28 days' AND {where:mail_sent} AND sender IN (SELECT email FROM staff) GROUP BY 1),
     t AS (SELECT (sender::jsonb) ->> 'id' AS pid, count(*) AS n FROM teams_messages
           WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '28 days' AND left(sender, 1) = '{' GROUP BY 1),
     g AS (SELECT organizer, count(DISTINCT ical_uid) AS n FROM meetings
           WHERE start_at >= now() - interval '28 days' AND NOT is_cancelled GROUP BY 1)
SELECT s.name AS person, s.department, coalesce(m.n, 0) AS mail_sent, coalesce(t.n, 0) AS teams_sent,
       coalesce(g.n, 0) AS meetings_organised, s.person_id
FROM staff s LEFT JOIN m ON m.sender = s.email LEFT JOIN t ON t.pid = s.person_id LEFT JOIN g ON g.organizer = s.email
WHERE coalesce(m.n, 0) + coalesce(t.n, 0) + coalesce(g.n, 0) > 0
ORDER BY coalesce(m.n, 0) + coalesce(t.n, 0) DESC

insights.title: Reply time per person, last 28 days
insights.about: Messages in each person's own mailbox addressed to them (To), from someone else, not bulk, received 1 to 28 days ago: how many, how many they answered in the same thread, and the median hours to their answer (over the ones answered). People with fewer than 5 answers are left out. Fastest first.
insights.sql:
SELECT s.name AS person, s.department, count(*) AS messages_to_them,
       count(e.owner_replied_at) AS replied,
       round(100.0 * count(e.owner_replied_at) / count(*)) AS replied_pct,
       round((percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM e.owner_replied_at - e.received_at) / 3600))::numeric, 1) AS median_reply_hours,
       s.person_id
FROM emails e JOIN staff s ON s.person_id = e.mailbox
WHERE e.received_at >= now() - interval '28 days' AND e.received_at < now() - interval '1 day'
  AND e.owner_role = 'to' AND NOT e.is_bulk AND e.sender <> s.email
GROUP BY s.name, s.department, s.person_id
HAVING count(e.owner_replied_at) >= 5
ORDER BY median_reply_hours NULLS LAST

insights.title: Threads waiting on each person
insights.about: Mail threads in each person's own mailbox from the last 30 days where they had written in the last 13 weeks, the latest message is to them (To) from someone else, not bulk, more than a day old, and they have not answered since. A blocker list: some are only 'thanks' notes, so open the person to see the threads.
insights.sql:
WITH st AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT person_id, name, department, email FROM staff),
last AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (mailbox, thread) mailbox, thread, sender, received_at, owner_role, is_bulk, owner_replied_at
  FROM emails WHERE thread IS NOT NULL AND received_at >= now() - interval '30 days' AND mailbox IN (SELECT person_id FROM st)
  ORDER BY mailbox, thread, received_at DESC, message_id DESC),
cand AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT l.mailbox, l.thread, l.sender, l.received_at FROM last l
  WHERE l.owner_role = 'to' AND NOT l.is_bulk AND l.owner_replied_at IS NULL AND l.received_at < now() - interval '1 day'),
wrote AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT mailbox, thread, sender FROM emails WHERE thread = ANY (ARRAY(SELECT thread FROM cand)) AND received_at >= now() - interval '91 days')
SELECT s.name AS person, s.department, count(*) AS threads_waiting,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE l.received_at < now() - interval '3 days') AS waiting_over_3_days,
       round((max(extract(epoch FROM now() - l.received_at)) / 86400)::numeric, 1) AS oldest_days,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE split_part(l.sender, '@', 2) <> split_part(s.email, '@', 2)) AS from_outside, s.person_id
FROM cand l JOIN st s ON s.person_id = l.mailbox
WHERE l.sender <> s.email
  AND (l.mailbox, l.thread, s.email) IN (SELECT mailbox, thread, sender FROM wrote)
GROUP BY s.name, s.department, s.person_id
ORDER BY threads_waiting DESC

insights.title: Who colleagues are waiting on
insights.about: Per person: mail threads in their own mailbox from the last 30 days where they had written in the last 13 weeks, the latest message is to them (To) from a colleague in the directory, not bulk, more than a day old, and they have not answered since; and one-to-one Teams chats from the last 30 days where they had written in the last 13 weeks and the latest message is a colleague's, more than a day old (group chats are not counted); how many colleagues sent those (one colleague by mail and Teams is one), how many threads and chats, how many are more than 3 days old and the oldest in days, beside the person's median hours to answer colleagues over the last 28 days (messages received 1 to 28 days ago that they answered in the same thread). Many colleagues waiting and a slow answer together mark a bottleneck. Some are only 'thanks' notes.
insights.sql:
WITH st AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT person_id, name, department, email FROM staff),
last AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (mailbox, thread) mailbox, thread, sender, received_at, owner_role, is_bulk, owner_replied_at
  FROM emails WHERE thread IS NOT NULL AND received_at >= now() - interval '30 days' AND mailbox IN (SELECT person_id FROM st)
  ORDER BY mailbox, thread, received_at DESC, message_id DESC),
cand AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT l.mailbox, l.thread, l.sender, l.received_at FROM last l
  WHERE l.owner_role = 'to' AND NOT l.is_bulk AND l.owner_replied_at IS NULL AND l.received_at < now() - interval '1 day'
    AND l.sender IN (SELECT email FROM st)),
wrote AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT mailbox, thread, sender FROM emails WHERE thread = ANY (ARRAY(SELECT thread FROM cand)) AND received_at >= now() - interval '91 days'),
rt AS (SELECT e.mailbox, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM e.owner_replied_at - e.received_at) / 3600) AS hours
       FROM emails e JOIN st s ON s.person_id = e.mailbox
       WHERE e.received_at >= now() - interval '28 days' AND e.received_at < now() - interval '1 day' AND e.owner_role = 'to'
         AND NOT e.is_bulk AND e.sender <> s.email AND e.sender IN (SELECT email FROM st) AND e.owner_replied_at IS NOT NULL
       GROUP BY 1),
tl AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (chat) chat, (sender::jsonb) ->> 'id' AS sid, created_at,
         split_part(split_part(chat, ':', 2), '@', 1) AS pair
  FROM teams_messages WHERE right(chat, 15) = '@unq.gbl.spaces' AND message_type = 'message' AND left(sender, 1) = '{'
    AND created_at >= now() - interval '30 days'
  ORDER BY chat, created_at DESC),
tw AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT x.pid, x.sid AS colleague, x.created_at AS at FROM (
    SELECT tl.*, CASE WHEN split_part(pair, '_', 1) = sid THEN split_part(pair, '_', 2) ELSE split_part(pair, '_', 1) END AS pid
    FROM tl WHERE pair ~ '^[^_]+_[^_]+$' AND sid IN (split_part(pair, '_', 1), split_part(pair, '_', 2))
      AND created_at < now() - interval '1 day') x
  WHERE x.pid <> x.sid AND x.pid IN (SELECT person_id FROM st) AND x.sid IN (SELECT person_id FROM st)
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM teams_messages m WHERE m.chat = x.chat AND left(m.sender, 1) = '{'
                AND m.created_at >= now() - interval '91 days' AND (m.sender::jsonb) ->> 'id' = x.pid)),
w AS (
  SELECT l.mailbox AS pid, (SELECT min(c.person_id) FROM st c WHERE c.email = l.sender) AS colleague, l.received_at AS at, 1 AS thread, 0 AS chat
  FROM cand l JOIN st s ON s.person_id = l.mailbox
  WHERE l.sender <> s.email AND (l.mailbox, l.thread, s.email) IN (SELECT mailbox, thread, sender FROM wrote)
  UNION ALL SELECT pid, colleague, at, 0, 1 FROM tw)
SELECT s.name AS person, s.department, count(DISTINCT w.colleague) AS colleagues_waiting, sum(w.thread) AS threads_waiting,
       sum(w.chat) AS chats_waiting, count(*) FILTER (WHERE w.at < now() - interval '3 days') AS waiting_over_3_days,
       round((max(extract(epoch FROM now() - w.at)) / 86400)::numeric, 1) AS oldest_days,
       round(max(rt.hours)::numeric, 1) AS median_reply_hours_to_colleagues, s.person_id
FROM w JOIN st s ON s.person_id = w.pid LEFT JOIN rt ON rt.mailbox = w.pid
GROUP BY s.name, s.department, s.person_id
ORDER BY colleagues_waiting DESC, count(*) DESC

insights.title: Span of control
insights.about: Each manager in the directory and how many people report directly to them (the org chart as the directory states it; people with no manager on record are not under anyone; a person not shown on the Team page is not counted).
insights.sql: SELECT m.name AS manager, m.department, m.person_id, r.person_id AS report_id FROM staff r JOIN staff m ON r.manager_email = m.email ORDER BY m.name

insights.title: Levels in the org chart
insights.about: How many people sit at each level below the top of each reporting chain (level 1: a manager with no manager on record), from the directory's manager links; a person with neither a manager nor reports on record is on no chain and is not counted (the directory states a manager for only some people); a person not shown on the Team page is not counted.
insights.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE chain AS (
  SELECT name, email, person_id, 1 AS level FROM staff WHERE manager_email IS NULL AND reports_count > 0
  UNION ALL
  SELECT s.name, s.email, s.person_id, c.level + 1 FROM staff s JOIN chain c ON s.manager_email = c.email WHERE c.level < 20)
SELECT level, person_id FROM chain ORDER BY level

insights.title: Team shape: people, managers and span per department
insights.about: Per department in the directory: people, managers (people with direct reports), the largest and average span of control, and people with no manager on record (an empty department is shown as (none)). The org chart is only as complete as the directory's manager links: a team where most people have no manager on record is not mapped there.
insights.sql:
SELECT coalesce(nullif(department, ''), '(none)') AS department, count(*) AS people,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE reports_count > 0) AS managers, max(reports_count) AS largest_span,
       round(avg(reports_count) FILTER (WHERE reports_count > 0), 1) AS average_span,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE manager_email IS NULL) AS no_manager_on_record
FROM staff GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY people DESC, 1

insights.title: Leader scorecard: each manager's team, last 28 days
insights.about: Per manager in the directory (someone with direct reports): direct reports, the whole team under them at every level (the leader not counted), how many of the team sent any mail or Teams message, what they sent (distinct emails from their work address plus Teams messages), the busiest member's share of it, and for mail addressed (To) to team members in their own mailboxes from someone else, not bulk, received 1 to 28 days ago: how many, the share answered in the same thread and the median hours to the answer; then the same reply rate and median hours for the manager's own mailbox. The team is only as complete as the directory's manager links, and a member whose mailbox is not captured adds no mail.
insights.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE st AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT person_id, name, department, email, manager_email, reports_count FROM staff),
tree AS (
  SELECT m.person_id AS leader, r.person_id AS member, r.email, 1 AS depth FROM st m JOIN st r ON r.manager_email = m.email
  UNION
  SELECT t.leader, r.person_id, r.email, t.depth + 1 FROM tree t JOIN st r ON r.manager_email = t.email WHERE t.depth < 20),
team AS (SELECT DISTINCT leader, member FROM tree WHERE member <> leader),
inb AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT e.mailbox, e.owner_replied_at, extract(epoch FROM e.owner_replied_at - e.received_at) / 3600 AS hours
  FROM emails e JOIN st s ON s.person_id = e.mailbox
  WHERE e.received_at >= now() - interval '28 days' AND e.received_at < now() - interval '1 day'
    AND e.owner_role = 'to' AND NOT e.is_bulk AND e.sender <> s.email),
m AS (SELECT sender, count(DISTINCT message_id) AS n FROM emails
      WHERE received_at >= now() - interval '28 days' AND sender IN (SELECT email FROM st) GROUP BY 1),
t AS (SELECT (sender::jsonb) ->> 'id' AS pid, count(*) AS n FROM teams_messages
      WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '28 days' AND left(sender, 1) = '{' GROUP BY 1),
work AS (SELECT st.person_id, coalesce(m.n, 0) + coalesce(t.n, 0) AS n FROM st LEFT JOIN m ON m.sender = st.email LEFT JOIN t ON t.pid = st.person_id),
tm AS (SELECT x.leader, count(*) AS messages, count(i.owner_replied_at) AS replied,
              percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY i.hours) AS median_hours
       FROM team x JOIN inb i ON i.mailbox = x.member GROUP BY 1),
tw AS (SELECT x.leader, count(*) AS people, count(*) FILTER (WHERE w.n > 0) AS active, sum(w.n) AS sent, max(w.n) AS busiest
       FROM team x JOIN work w ON w.person_id = x.member GROUP BY 1),
own AS (SELECT mailbox, count(*) AS messages, count(owner_replied_at) AS replied,
               percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY hours) AS median_hours FROM inb GROUP BY 1)
SELECT l.name AS leader, l.department, l.reports_count AS direct_reports, tw.people AS team_size,
       tw.active AS team_active, tw.sent AS team_sent,
       round(100.0 * tw.busiest / nullif(tw.sent, 0)) AS busiest_member_share_pct,
       tm.messages AS team_messages_to_them, round(100.0 * tm.replied / nullif(tm.messages, 0)) AS team_replied_pct,
       round(tm.median_hours::numeric, 1) AS team_median_reply_hours,
       round(100.0 * own.replied / nullif(own.messages, 0)) AS leader_replied_pct,
       round(own.median_hours::numeric, 1) AS leader_median_reply_hours, l.person_id
FROM st l JOIN tw ON tw.leader = l.person_id LEFT JOIN tm ON tm.leader = l.person_id LEFT JOIN own ON own.mailbox = l.person_id
ORDER BY tw.people DESC, l.name

insights.title: Reply time and reply rate per department, last 28 days
insights.about: Per department: mail addressed (To) to its people in their own mailboxes from someone else, not bulk, received 1 to 28 days ago; how many they answered in the same thread and the median hours to the answer. Many To messages need no answer (notices, thanks), so the rate is a comparison between teams, not a target. People with no department are shown as (none).
insights.sql:
SELECT coalesce(nullif(s.department, ''), '(none)') AS department, count(DISTINCT s.person_id) AS people,
       count(*) AS messages_to_them, count(e.owner_replied_at) AS replied,
       round(100.0 * count(e.owner_replied_at) / count(*)) AS replied_pct,
       round((percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM e.owner_replied_at - e.received_at) / 3600))::numeric, 1) AS median_reply_hours
FROM emails e JOIN staff s ON s.person_id = e.mailbox
WHERE e.received_at >= now() - interval '28 days' AND e.received_at < now() - interval '1 day'
  AND e.owner_role = 'to' AND NOT e.is_bulk AND e.sender <> s.email
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY median_reply_hours NULLS LAST

insights.title: Workload balance per department, last 28 days
insights.about: Per department in the directory: people, how many sent any mail or Teams message in the last 28 days, what they sent (distinct emails from their work address plus Teams messages), the median per person who sent any, the busiest person's count and share, and how few people send half of it (1 means one person sends at least half). Floor, lab and phone work is not seen. People with no department are shown as (none).
insights.sql:
WITH m AS (SELECT sender, count(DISTINCT message_id) AS n FROM emails
           WHERE sent_at >= now() - interval '28 days' AND {where:mail_sent} AND sender IN (SELECT email FROM staff) GROUP BY 1),
     t AS (SELECT (sender::jsonb) ->> 'id' AS pid, count(*) AS n FROM teams_messages
           WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '28 days' AND left(sender, 1) = '{' GROUP BY 1),
     w AS (SELECT coalesce(nullif(s.department, ''), '(none)') AS department, coalesce(m.n, 0) + coalesce(t.n, 0) AS n
           FROM staff s LEFT JOIN m ON m.sender = s.email LEFT JOIN t ON t.pid = s.person_id),
     r AS (SELECT department, n, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY department ORDER BY n DESC) AS rank,
                  sum(n) OVER (PARTITION BY department ORDER BY n DESC ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS running,
                  sum(n) OVER (PARTITION BY department) AS total FROM w)
SELECT department, count(*) AS people, count(*) FILTER (WHERE n > 0) AS active, sum(n) AS sent,
       round((percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY n) FILTER (WHERE n > 0))::numeric, 1) AS median_per_active_person,
       max(n) AS busiest_person, round(100.0 * max(n) / nullif(sum(n), 0)) AS busiest_share_pct,
       min(rank) FILTER (WHERE total > 0 AND 2 * running >= total) AS people_sending_half
FROM r GROUP BY department ORDER BY sent DESC, department

insights.title: Mail sent by our people per week
insights.about: Distinct non-bulk emails sent from a staff address domain per week (Monday start, business time zone), the last 12 weeks: the Mail sent measure, the same number Ask and the pages give.
insights.sql: SELECT to_char(date_trunc('week', e.sent_at AT TIME ZONE '{business_tz}'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS week, count(DISTINCT e.message_id) AS mail_sent FROM emails e WHERE {where:mail_sent} AND e.sent_at >= (date_trunc('week', now() AT TIME ZONE '{business_tz}') - interval '12 weeks') AT TIME ZONE '{business_tz}' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

insights.title: Customers by mail, last 28 days
insights.about: Customers by the number of distinct non-bulk emails about them or from them in the mail you can read over the last 28 days, with the threads and how many came from outside our domain. A customer is linked to a message by the mail's customer links. This is its own count, not the Mail received measure: that one counts only mail from outside our domain addressed to our people, with no customer link needed; this one counts mail in both directions that the customer links name.
insights.sql: SELECT c.name AS customer, count(DISTINCT e.message_id) AS messages, count(DISTINCT e.thread) AS threads, count(DISTINCT e.message_id) FILTER (WHERE e.sender_domain IS DISTINCT FROM split_part(s.email, '@', 2)) AS from_them FROM emails e JOIN customers c ON c.handle = ANY(e.customers) LEFT JOIN staff s ON s.person_id = e.mailbox WHERE e.received_at >= now() - interval '28 days' AND NOT e.is_bulk AND coalesce(c.name, '') !~* '\m(do\s+not\s+use|don''?t\s+use)\M' GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY messages DESC LIMIT 25

insights.title: Customers waiting on us
insights.about: Customers whose latest message in a thread to one of our people (in that person's own mailbox, addressed to them, not bulk) has had no answer from that person for more than a day, over the last 30 days: how many threads, how many of our people they wait on, and the oldest wait in days. A colleague's answer from another mailbox is not seen unless that person was copied.
insights.sql: WITH last AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (e.mailbox, e.thread) e.mailbox, e.thread, e.sender, e.sender_domain, e.received_at, e.owner_role, e.is_bulk, e.owner_replied_at, e.customers FROM emails e WHERE e.thread IS NOT NULL AND e.received_at >= now() - interval '30 days' AND e.mailbox IN (SELECT person_id FROM staff) ORDER BY e.mailbox, e.thread, e.received_at DESC, e.message_id DESC) SELECT c.name AS customer, count(*) AS threads_waiting, count(DISTINCT l.mailbox) AS people_waited_on, round((max(extract(epoch FROM now() - l.received_at)) / 86400)::numeric, 1) AS oldest_days FROM last l JOIN staff s ON s.person_id = l.mailbox JOIN customers c ON c.handle = ANY(l.customers) WHERE l.owner_role = 'to' AND NOT l.is_bulk AND l.owner_replied_at IS NULL AND l.sender <> s.email AND l.sender_domain IS DISTINCT FROM split_part(s.email, '@', 2) AND l.received_at < now() - interval '1 day' AND coalesce(c.name, '') !~* '\m(do\s+not\s+use|don''?t\s+use)\M' GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY threads_waiting DESC, oldest_days DESC LIMIT 25

insights.title: Waiting on someone outside, per person
insights.about: Threads in each person's own mailbox from the last 30 days where they wrote the latest message, to at least one address outside our domain, more than 3 days ago, and nobody has written in the thread since: what they are waiting on others for, and the oldest in days. Some are closing notes that need no answer.
insights.sql: WITH last AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (e.mailbox, e.thread) e.mailbox, e.thread, e.sender, e.received_at, e.to_addresses FROM emails e WHERE e.thread IS NOT NULL AND e.received_at >= now() - interval '30 days' AND e.mailbox IN (SELECT person_id FROM staff) ORDER BY e.mailbox, e.thread, e.received_at DESC, e.message_id DESC) SELECT s.name AS person, s.department, count(*) AS threads_waiting, round((max(extract(epoch FROM now() - l.received_at)) / 86400)::numeric, 1) AS oldest_days, s.person_id FROM last l JOIN staff s ON s.person_id = l.mailbox AND l.sender = s.email WHERE l.received_at < now() - interval '3 days' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unnest(l.to_addresses) a WHERE split_part(a, '@', 2) <> split_part(s.email, '@', 2)) GROUP BY s.name, s.department, s.person_id ORDER BY threads_waiting DESC

insights.title: Open Planner tasks per person
insights.about: Microsoft Planner tasks not completed, per person they are assigned to (a task with two assignees counts for each): how many are open, how many are past their due date, and how many of those are more than 90 days past it (often tasks nobody closed).
insights.sql: SELECT s.name AS person, s.department, count(*) AS open_tasks, count(*) FILTER (WHERE coalesce(r.fields->>'due_at', '') <> '' AND (r.fields->>'due_at')::timestamptz < now()) AS overdue, count(*) FILTER (WHERE coalesce(r.fields->>'due_at', '') <> '' AND (r.fields->>'due_at')::timestamptz < now() - interval '90 days') AS overdue_90_days, s.person_id FROM records r CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(r.fields->'assignees') = 'array' THEN r.fields->'assignees' WHEN jsonb_typeof(r.fields->'assignees') = 'string' AND left(btrim(r.fields->>'assignees'), 1) = '[' THEN (r.fields->>'assignees')::jsonb ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) a(pid) JOIN staff s ON s.person_id = a.pid WHERE r.type = 'PlannerTask' AND coalesce(r.fields->>'completed_at', '') = '' GROUP BY s.name, s.department, s.person_id ORDER BY open_tasks DESC

insights.title: Approvals decided in Mission Control, last 30 days
insights.about: Mission Control approval requests decided in the last 30 days, per person who decided: how many approved and how many rejected. Who asked and what for is on each request (Ask: 'which approvals did <name> reject this month?').
insights.sql: SELECT coalesce(s.name, r.fields->>'decided_by') AS decided_by, count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.fields->>'status' = 'approved') AS approved, count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.fields->>'status' = 'rejected') AS rejected FROM records r LEFT JOIN staff s ON s.email = lower(r.fields->>'decided_by') WHERE r.type = 'MCApproval' AND coalesce(r.fields->>'decided_at', '') <> '' AND (r.fields->>'decided_at')::timestamptz >= now() - interval '30 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

insights.title: Approvals still waiting for a decision
insights.about: Mission Control approval requests with no decision yet, per person who asked: how many are waiting and the oldest in days.
insights.sql: SELECT coalesce(s.name, r.fields->>'requested_by') AS requested_by, count(*) AS waiting, round((max(extract(epoch FROM now() - (r.fields->>'requested_at')::timestamptz)) / 86400)::numeric, 1) AS oldest_days FROM records r LEFT JOIN staff s ON s.email = lower(r.fields->>'requested_by') WHERE r.type = 'MCApproval' AND r.fields->>'status' = 'pending' AND coalesce(r.fields->>'requested_at', '') <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

insights.title: How fast approvals are decided, last 30 days
insights.about: Mission Control approval requests decided in the last 30 days, per person who decided: how many, the median minutes from the request to the decision, the hours within which nine in ten were decided, the share decided within an hour, and how many were rejected.
insights.sql:
WITH a AS (SELECT lower(r.fields->>'decided_by') AS who, r.fields->>'status' AS status,
                  extract(epoch FROM (r.fields->>'decided_at')::timestamptz - (r.fields->>'requested_at')::timestamptz) / 60 AS minutes
           FROM records r WHERE r.type = 'MCApproval' AND coalesce(r.fields->>'decided_at', '') <> ''
             AND coalesce(r.fields->>'requested_at', '') <> '' AND (r.fields->>'decided_at')::timestamptz >= now() - interval '30 days')
SELECT coalesce(s.name, a.who) AS decided_by, count(*) AS decided,
       round((percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY a.minutes))::numeric, 1) AS median_minutes,
       round((percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY a.minutes) / 60)::numeric, 1) AS slowest_tenth_hours,
       round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.minutes <= 60) / count(*)) AS within_an_hour_pct,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.status = 'rejected') AS rejected
FROM a LEFT JOIN staff s ON s.email = a.who GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY decided DESC

insights.title: Decisions in mail and Teams, last 14 days
insights.about: Decisions, agreements and confirmations stated in the mail and Teams messages you can read over the last 14 days, newest first: who decided and what, and how many whole days ago. One row per person and subject in a conversation (messages says how many said it). Each is a one-line reading of a message; Ask to see the message itself.
insights.sql: WITH named AS (SELECT f.*, coalesce(CASE WHEN length(btrim(f.who)) < 2 OR left(btrim(f.who), 1) = '{' OR lower(btrim(f.who)) ~ '^(us|we|i|me|they|you|our team|petra staff|customer|supplier|vendor|sender|speaker|colleague|someone|unknown|outside( sender| party| supplier| customer)?)( \(.*\))?$' THEN NULL ELSE btrim(f.who) END, s.name, CASE WHEN f.sender LIKE '{%' THEN coalesce(nullif(btrim(substring(f.sender FROM '"display_name"\s*:\s*"([^"]*)"')), ''), 'Teams ' || coalesce(substring(f.sender FROM '"kind"\s*:\s*"([a-z]+)"'), 'user') || ' ' || substring(f.sender FROM '"id"\s*:\s*"([^"]+)"'), 'Unknown sender') END, nullif(btrim(f.sender), ''), 'Unknown sender') AS by_whom, coalesce(nullif(f.thread, ''), f.handle) AS thread_key FROM comms_findings f LEFT JOIN staff s ON (f.source = 'email' AND s.email = lower(f.sender)) OR (f.source = 'teams' AND s.person_id = substring(f.sender FROM '"id"\s*:\s*"([^"]+)"')) WHERE f.kind = 'decision' AND f.said_at >= now() - interval '14 days'), issues AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (thread_key, by_whom, topic) *, count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY thread_key, by_whom, topic) AS messages FROM named ORDER BY thread_key, by_whom, topic, said_at DESC) SELECT by_whom || ': ' || summary AS decision, floor(extract(epoch FROM now() - said_at) / 86400)::int AS days_ago, messages, topic, source, handle FROM issues ORDER BY said_at DESC LIMIT 100

insights.title: Who decides, asks and complains, by department, last 30 days
insights.about: Decisions, requests and complaints found in the mail and Teams messages of the last 30 days, counted by the department of the person who wrote the message (from the directory: their work address for mail, their account for Teams). Messages from outside PLX are counted as (outside); a PLX sender the directory has no department for as (no department). Each finding is a model's one-line reading of one message.
insights.sql:
SELECT CASE WHEN s.person_id IS NULL THEN '(outside)' ELSE coalesce(nullif(s.department, ''), '(no department)') END AS department,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.kind = 'decision') AS decisions, count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.kind = 'request') AS requests,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.kind = 'complaint') AS complaints, count(DISTINCT s.person_id) AS people
FROM comms_findings f
LEFT JOIN staff s ON (f.source = 'email' AND s.email = f.sender)
                  OR (f.source = 'teams' AND left(f.sender, 1) = '{' AND s.person_id = (f.sender::jsonb) ->> 'id')
WHERE f.said_at >= now() - interval '30 days'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY decisions DESC, requests DESC

insights.title: How each team decides, last 30 days
insights.about: Per department of the person who stated a decision in mail or Teams (from the directory; outside senders left out), last 30 days: decisions, how many people stated them, the share stated by the one who stated most, the share stated by a manager on record (someone with reports), how many followed an earlier request in the same thread or chat, the median hours from that request to the decision, how many of those requests came from another team or outside, and how many were taken to the asker's own manager (only where the directory names the asker's manager), with the latest example. Each finding is a model's one-line reading of one message; a team with few managers on record shows fewer of them.
insights.sql:
WITH f AS (
  SELECT f.kind, f.summary, f.said_at, f.thread, f.source, s.person_id, s.email, s.manager_email, s.reports_count,
         CASE WHEN s.person_id IS NULL THEN '(outside)' ELSE coalesce(nullif(s.department, ''), '(no department)') END AS department,
         coalesce(CASE WHEN length(btrim(f.who)) < 2 OR left(btrim(f.who), 1) = '{' THEN NULL ELSE btrim(f.who) END, s.name, CASE WHEN f.sender LIKE '{%' THEN coalesce(nullif(btrim(substring(f.sender FROM '"display_name"\s*:\s*"([^"]*)"')), ''), 'Teams ' || coalesce(substring(f.sender FROM '"kind"\s*:\s*"([a-z]+)"'), 'user'), 'Unknown sender') END, nullif(btrim(f.sender), ''), 'Unknown sender') AS by_whom
  FROM comms_findings f
  LEFT JOIN staff s ON (f.source = 'email' AND s.email = f.sender)
                    OR (f.source = 'teams' AND left(f.sender, 1) = '{' AND s.person_id = (f.sender::jsonb) ->> 'id')
  WHERE f.said_at >= now() - interval '30 days' AND f.kind IN ('decision', 'request') AND f.thread IS NOT NULL),
d AS (SELECT * FROM f WHERE kind = 'decision' AND department <> '(outside)'),
dr AS (SELECT d.*, q.said_at AS asked_at, q.department AS asked_department, q.manager_email AS asker_manager
       FROM d LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT r.said_at, r.department, r.manager_email FROM f r
                                 WHERE r.kind = 'request' AND r.thread = d.thread AND r.source = d.source
                                   AND r.said_at < d.said_at ORDER BY r.said_at LIMIT 1) q ON true),
top AS (SELECT department, max(n) AS top_n FROM (SELECT department, person_id, count(*) AS n FROM d GROUP BY 1, 2) x GROUP BY 1)
SELECT dr.department, count(*) AS decisions, count(DISTINCT dr.person_id) AS deciders,
       round(100.0 * max(top.top_n) / count(*)) AS top_decider_pct,
       round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE dr.reports_count > 0) / count(*)) AS by_a_manager_pct,
       count(dr.asked_at) AS after_a_request,
       round((percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM dr.said_at - dr.asked_at) / 3600))::numeric, 1) AS median_hours_to_decide,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE dr.asked_at IS NOT NULL AND dr.asked_department <> dr.department) AS asked_by_another_team,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE dr.asker_manager IS NOT NULL AND dr.asker_manager = dr.email) AS taken_to_their_manager,
       (array_agg(dr.by_whom || ': ' || dr.summary ORDER BY dr.said_at DESC))[1] AS latest_example
FROM dr JOIN top USING (department)
GROUP BY dr.department ORDER BY decisions DESC

insights.title: Complaints and praise from outside, by topic, last 90 days
insights.about: Complaints and praise from customers, suppliers and other outside parties in the mail and Teams messages you can read over the last 90 days, counted per topic (delivery, quality, pricing ...). Read by a model from each message; our own staff's messages are left out.
insights.sql: SELECT f.topic, count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.kind = 'complaint') AS complaints, count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.kind = 'praise') AS praise FROM comms_findings f WHERE f.kind IN ('complaint', 'praise') AND f.from_side IN ('customer', 'outside') AND f.said_at >= now() - interval '90 days' GROUP BY f.topic ORDER BY complaints DESC, praise DESC

insights.title: Latest complaints from outside, last 30 days
insights.about: The complaints customers, suppliers and other outside parties made in the mail and Teams messages you can read over the last 30 days, newest first: who (the customer when the message is linked to one) and what, and how many whole days ago. One row per person and subject in a conversation (messages says how many said it).
insights.sql: WITH named AS (SELECT f.*, coalesce(CASE WHEN length(btrim(f.who)) < 2 OR left(btrim(f.who), 1) = '{' OR lower(btrim(f.who)) ~ '^(us|we|i|me|they|you|our team|petra staff|customer|supplier|vendor|sender|speaker|colleague|someone|unknown|outside( sender| party| supplier| customer)?)( \(.*\))?$' THEN NULL ELSE btrim(f.who) END, s.name, CASE WHEN f.sender LIKE '{%' THEN coalesce(nullif(btrim(substring(f.sender FROM '"display_name"\s*:\s*"([^"]*)"')), ''), 'Teams ' || coalesce(substring(f.sender FROM '"kind"\s*:\s*"([a-z]+)"'), 'user') || ' ' || substring(f.sender FROM '"id"\s*:\s*"([^"]+)"'), 'Unknown sender') END, nullif(btrim(f.sender), ''), 'Unknown sender') AS by_whom, coalesce(nullif(f.thread, ''), f.handle) AS thread_key FROM comms_findings f LEFT JOIN staff s ON (f.source = 'email' AND s.email = lower(f.sender)) OR (f.source = 'teams' AND s.person_id = substring(f.sender FROM '"id"\s*:\s*"([^"]+)"')) WHERE f.kind = 'complaint' AND f.from_side IN ('customer', 'outside') AND f.said_at >= now() - interval '30 days'), issues AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (thread_key, by_whom, topic) *, count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY thread_key, by_whom, topic) AS messages FROM named ORDER BY thread_key, by_whom, topic, said_at DESC) SELECT coalesce((SELECT c.name FROM customers c WHERE c.handle = ANY(i.customers) ORDER BY c.name LIMIT 1), by_whom) || ': ' || summary AS complaint, floor(extract(epoch FROM now() - said_at) / 86400)::int AS days_ago, messages, topic, handle FROM issues i ORDER BY said_at DESC LIMIT 100

insights.title: What customers and suppliers asked us for, last 30 days
insights.about: Requests customers, suppliers and other outside parties made in the mail and Teams messages you can read over the last 30 days, counted per topic, with the last 7 days beside. Read by a model from each message; our own staff's requests to each other are left out.
insights.sql: SELECT f.topic, count(*) AS requests, count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.said_at >= now() - interval '7 days') AS last_7_days FROM comms_findings f WHERE f.kind = 'request' AND f.from_side IN ('customer', 'outside') AND f.said_at >= now() - interval '30 days' GROUP BY f.topic ORDER BY requests DESC

insights.title: Supplier lead time: days from PO to first receipt, last 12 months against the 12 before
insights.about: Purchase orders with a posted receipt linked to them (Receipt.receives), per supplier: POs received in the last 365 days, the median and slowest-tenth days from the PO's order date to its first receipt, the median for the 365 days before, and the drift (now minus before; positive is slower). Draft POs and BC pilot POs (held only in Business Central) are left out. Receipts dated before their PO's order date are left out and counted. Coverage: only receipts linked to a PO the purchase orders view holds (Sage receipts, about 50 a quarter; FileMaker receipts carry no PO link yet), suppliers with at least 3 receipted POs in the year.
insights.sql:
WITH x AS (SELECT p.supplier, p.po_number, p.order_date, min((r.fields->>'received_date')::date) AS received
  FROM record_links l JOIN purchase_orders p ON p.handle = l.to_handle
  JOIN LATERAL (SELECT fields FROM records WHERE records.handle = l.from_handle AND records.type = 'Receipt' LIMIT 1) r ON true
  WHERE l.link_type = 'Receipt.receives' AND p.order_date IS NOT NULL
    AND p.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'draft' AND NOT (coalesce(p.source_systems, '') = 'bc')
    AND coalesce(r.fields->>'received_date', '') ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$'
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3),
y AS (SELECT supplier, received - order_date AS days, received >= (now() AT TIME ZONE '{business_tz}')::date - 365 AS recent,
  received < (now() AT TIME ZONE '{business_tz}')::date - 365 AND received >= (now() AT TIME ZONE '{business_tz}')::date - 730 AS before FROM x)
SELECT supplier, count(*) FILTER (WHERE recent AND days >= 0) AS pos_received,
  round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY days) FILTER (WHERE recent AND days >= 0)::numeric, 1) AS median_days,
  round(percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY days) FILTER (WHERE recent AND days >= 0)::numeric, 1) AS slowest_tenth_days,
  round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY days) FILTER (WHERE before AND days >= 0)::numeric, 1) AS median_days_before,
  round((percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY days) FILTER (WHERE recent AND days >= 0)
    - percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY days) FILTER (WHERE before AND days >= 0))::numeric, 1) AS drift_days,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE recent AND days < 0) AS received_before_ordered
FROM y GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*) FILTER (WHERE recent AND days >= 0) >= 3
ORDER BY pos_received DESC, supplier

insights.title: Revenue outlook for this month, per currency
insights.about: Revenue invoiced (the revenue measure: net line revenue on posted Sage invoices before tax, BC pilot left out) per currency: this month so far, the month projected three ways (the run rate so far times the days in the month; the average of the last 3 full months; the straight-line trend of the last 12 full months carried one month on), and the last 12 full months' average. A projection, not a commitment: it says nothing about orders not yet invoiced.
insights.sql:
WITH m AS (SELECT revenue_currency AS currency, date_trunc('month', invoice_date)::date AS month, sum(revenue) AS revenue
  FROM sales_invoice_lines WHERE NOT pilot AND revenue_currency IS NOT NULL
    AND invoice_date >= (date_trunc('month', (now() AT TIME ZONE '{business_tz}')::date) - interval '12 months')::date
    AND invoice_date < date_trunc('month', (now() AT TIME ZONE '{business_tz}')::date)::date GROUP BY 1, 2),
f AS (SELECT currency, count(*) AS full_months, avg(revenue) AS avg_12,
  avg(revenue) FILTER (WHERE month >= (date_trunc('month', (now() AT TIME ZONE '{business_tz}')::date) - interval '3 months')::date) AS avg_3,
  regr_slope(revenue, (month - DATE '2000-01-01')::numeric) AS slope, regr_intercept(revenue, (month - DATE '2000-01-01')::numeric) AS intercept FROM m GROUP BY 1),
t AS (SELECT revenue_currency AS currency, sum(revenue) AS so_far FROM sales_invoice_lines
  WHERE NOT pilot AND revenue_currency IS NOT NULL AND invoice_date >= date_trunc('month', (now() AT TIME ZONE '{business_tz}')::date)::date AND invoice_date <= (now() AT TIME ZONE '{business_tz}')::date GROUP BY 1)
SELECT f.currency, round(coalesce(t.so_far, 0), 2) AS month_so_far,
  round(coalesce(t.so_far, 0) * extract(day FROM (date_trunc('month', (now() AT TIME ZONE '{business_tz}')::date) + interval '1 month - 1 day'))::numeric / extract(day FROM (now() AT TIME ZONE '{business_tz}')::date)::numeric, 2) AS run_rate_projection,
  round(f.avg_3, 2) AS last_3_months_average,
  round((f.intercept + f.slope * (date_trunc('month', (now() AT TIME ZONE '{business_tz}')::date)::date - DATE '2000-01-01'))::numeric, 2) AS trend_projection,
  round(f.avg_12, 2) AS last_12_months_average, f.full_months
FROM f LEFT JOIN t ON t.currency = f.currency ORDER BY f.currency

insights.title: Finished goods: open customer orders against stock on hand, in pieces
insights.about: Open Sage order lines of record with quantity outstanding, mapped to the FileMaker finished product that carries their item code as its ERP code, in pieces: the order unit's Sage conversion over Sage's each (a whole number when within 1%); an item whose Sage case size and FileMaker units per box differ by more than 1% is not mapped. Per finished product: stock on hand in pieces (FileMaker/Portal stock, as of its date; negative as recorded), open order pieces, short by (open less on hand; above 0: to make or find), the open orders and lines, the oldest order date, the first required date (most Sage orders state none), FileMaker's lead time in days, the Sage item codes, and whether the unit was checked against a case size. Lines that cannot be mapped are one '(not mapped) <reason>' row per reason with their counts: never guessed. BC pilot stock (held only in Business Central) is not used; two stock rows of one finished product are one figure only when they agree (else '(not mapped) stock records ... disagree'), never added.
insights.sql:
WITH fp AS (SELECT upper(btrim(fields->>'erp_code')) AS erp, min(fields->>'code') AS code,
    count(DISTINCT fields->>'code') AS codes,
    max(CASE WHEN fields->>'units_per_box' ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN (fields->>'units_per_box')::numeric END) AS per_box,
    max(CASE WHEN fields->>'lead_time' ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN (fields->>'lead_time')::numeric END) AS lead_days
  FROM records WHERE type = 'RelSilverFinishedProducts' AND coalesce(btrim(fields->>'erp_code'), '') <> '' GROUP BY 1),
um AS (SELECT upper(btrim(fields->>'item_number')) AS item, upper(btrim(fields->>'unit')) AS unit,
    max(CASE WHEN fields->>'conversion' ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN (fields->>'conversion')::numeric END) AS conv
  FROM records WHERE type = 'ItemUnitOfMeasure' GROUP BY 1, 2),
st AS (SELECT item_code, max(name) AS name, CASE WHEN min(on_hand) = max(on_hand) THEN max(on_hand) END AS on_hand, max(as_of) AS as_of
  FROM stock WHERE on_hand_unit = 'PCS' AND source_systems IS DISTINCT FROM 'bc' GROUP BY 1),
ol AS (SELECT l.order_number, l.item_code, l.outstanding_quantity AS qty, upper(btrim(r.unit)) AS unit, o.required_date, o.order_date
  FROM sales_order_lines l
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT fields->>'ordered_quantity_unit' AS unit FROM records WHERE records.handle = l.handle AND records.type = 'SalesOrderLine' LIMIT 1) r ON true
  LEFT JOIN sales_orders o ON o.handle = l.order_handle
  WHERE l.order_status = 'open' AND l.of_record AND l.outstanding_quantity > 0 AND l.item_code IS NOT NULL),
m AS (SELECT ol.*, CASE WHEN u.conv / nullif(ea.conv, 0) >= 0.5 AND abs(u.conv / ea.conv - round(u.conv / ea.conv)) <= 0.01 * round(u.conv / ea.conv) THEN round(u.conv / ea.conv) ELSE u.conv / nullif(ea.conv, 0) END AS pieces_per_unit, fp.code, fp.lead_days, u.conv AS unit_conv, ea.conv AS each_conv, cs.conv AS case_conv, st.name, st.on_hand, st.as_of,
    CASE WHEN fp.erp IS NULL THEN 'no FileMaker finished product carries the item code'
         WHEN fp.codes > 1 THEN 'several FileMaker finished products carry the item code'
         WHEN u.conv IS NULL OR ea.conv IS NULL OR ea.conv <= 0 THEN 'Sage states no conversion of the order unit to each'
         WHEN cs.conv IS NOT NULL AND (fp.per_box IS NULL OR abs(cs.conv / ea.conv - fp.per_box) > 0.01 * fp.per_box) THEN 'case size differs between Sage and FileMaker'
         WHEN st.item_code IS NULL THEN 'no stock record in pieces for the finished product'
         WHEN st.on_hand IS NULL THEN 'stock records for the finished product disagree' END AS not_mapped
  FROM ol LEFT JOIN fp ON fp.erp = upper(btrim(ol.item_code))
  LEFT JOIN um u ON u.item = upper(btrim(ol.item_code)) AND u.unit = ol.unit
  LEFT JOIN um ea ON ea.item = upper(btrim(ol.item_code)) AND ea.unit = 'EA'
  LEFT JOIN um cs ON cs.item = upper(btrim(ol.item_code)) AND cs.unit = 'CSE'
  LEFT JOIN st ON st.item_code = fp.code),
d AS (SELECT code, max(name) AS name, max(on_hand) AS on_hand, sum(qty * pieces_per_unit) AS open_pieces,
    count(DISTINCT order_number) AS open_orders, count(*) AS open_lines, min(order_date) AS oldest_order, min(required_date) AS first_required,
    max(lead_days) AS lead_days, string_agg(DISTINCT item_code, ', ') AS order_items, bool_and(case_conv IS NOT NULL) AS case_checked, max(as_of) AS stock_as_of
  FROM m WHERE not_mapped IS NULL GROUP BY 1)
SELECT code AS item, name, on_hand, round(open_pieces, 2) AS open_order_pieces, round(open_pieces - on_hand, 2) AS short_by,
  open_orders, open_lines, oldest_order, first_required, lead_days AS lead_time_days, order_items,
  CASE WHEN case_checked THEN 'case size checked (Sage = FileMaker)' ELSE 'each only (no case to check)' END AS unit_basis, stock_as_of
FROM d
UNION ALL
SELECT '(not mapped) ' || not_mapped, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, count(DISTINCT order_number), count(*), min(order_date), min(required_date), NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL
FROM m WHERE not_mapped IS NOT NULL GROUP BY not_mapped
ORDER BY short_by DESC NULLS LAST, item

insights.title: Receivables to chase: overdue per customer, oldest first to act on
insights.about: Open receivable documents (customer balances, net of credits) per customer name and currency (a customer with several Sage accounts is one row; Accounts overdue says how many are overdue): overdue (past due, net), overdue over 60 days, the oldest days overdue and due date and the overdue documents (owing documents only), what they owe in all, and the customer's contact, email, phone and salesperson as Sage holds them (of its account with the most overdue): from the customer row with that code and the balance's own customer name, else the only row with that code; a code several customers share with none of that name gives no contact (never another customer's). Customers with something overdue only; the largest overdue first in each currency. Money in its own currency, never converted.
insights.sql:
WITH b AS (SELECT customer, customer_code, amount_due_currency AS currency, amount_due, days_overdue, document_type, due_date FROM customer_balances WHERE amount_due IS NOT NULL AND coalesce(customer, '') !~* '\m(do\s+not\s+use|don''?t\s+use)\M'),
o AS (SELECT customer, customer_code, currency,
    sum(amount_due) AS owed,
    sum(amount_due) FILTER (WHERE days_overdue > 0) AS overdue,
    sum(amount_due) FILTER (WHERE days_overdue > 60) AS overdue_over_60,
    max(days_overdue) FILTER (WHERE days_overdue > 0 AND amount_due > 0) AS oldest_days_overdue,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE days_overdue > 0 AND amount_due > 0) AS overdue_documents,
    min(due_date) FILTER (WHERE days_overdue > 0 AND amount_due > 0) AS oldest_due
  FROM b GROUP BY 1, 2, 3),
r AS (SELECT o.customer, o.customer_code, o.currency, o.overdue, o.overdue_over_60, o.oldest_days_overdue,
  o.overdue_documents, o.oldest_due, o.owed, c.contact_person, c.email, c.phone, c.salesperson
FROM o LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT contact_person, email, phone, salesperson FROM customers k
  WHERE k.customer_code = o.customer_code AND (k.name = o.customer
    OR (SELECT count(*) FROM customers k2 WHERE k2.customer_code = o.customer_code) = 1)
  ORDER BY k.name = o.customer DESC, k.handle LIMIT 1) c ON true)
SELECT customer, currency, round(sum(overdue), 2) AS overdue, round(sum(overdue_over_60), 2) AS overdue_over_60,
  max(oldest_days_overdue) AS oldest_days_overdue, sum(overdue_documents) AS overdue_documents, min(oldest_due) AS oldest_due,
  round(sum(owed), 2) AS owed_in_total, count(*) FILTER (WHERE overdue > 0) AS accounts_overdue,
  (array_agg(contact_person ORDER BY overdue DESC NULLS LAST, customer_code))[1] AS contact_person,
  (array_agg(email ORDER BY overdue DESC NULLS LAST, customer_code))[1] AS email,
  (array_agg(phone ORDER BY overdue DESC NULLS LAST, customer_code))[1] AS phone,
  (array_agg(salesperson ORDER BY overdue DESC NULLS LAST, customer_code))[1] AS salesperson
FROM r GROUP BY customer, currency HAVING sum(overdue) > 0
ORDER BY currency, sum(overdue) DESC

insights.title: Customers gone quiet: invoiced in the year before, nothing in the last 90 days
insights.about: Customers with posted Sage invoice lines (the revenue measure's lines: BC pilot left out) in the 365 days before the last 90 days and none in the last 90: their chain, last invoice date, days since, revenue in that year per currency and the days they were invoiced, and whether another customer of the same chain was invoiced in the last 90 days (a chain still buying under another account). Largest revenue first. A customer billed under a new account reads as quiet here.
insights.sql:
WITH t AS (SELECT (now() AT TIME ZONE '{business_tz}')::date AS today),
l AS (SELECT customer, customer_chain, revenue_currency AS currency, invoice_date, revenue FROM sales_invoice_lines
  WHERE NOT pilot AND customer IS NOT NULL AND customer !~* '\m(do\s+not\s+use|don''?t\s+use)\M' AND invoice_date > (SELECT today FROM t) - 455 AND invoice_date <= (SELECT today FROM t)),
c AS (SELECT customer, max(invoice_date) AS last_invoiced FROM l GROUP BY 1),
h AS (SELECT customer_chain, max(invoice_date) AS chain_last FROM l WHERE customer_chain IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1)
SELECT l.customer, l.customer_chain, l.currency, c.last_invoiced, (SELECT today FROM t) - c.last_invoiced AS days_since_last_invoice,
  round(sum(l.revenue), 2) AS revenue_in_the_year_before, count(DISTINCT l.invoice_date) AS invoice_days,
  h.chain_last > (SELECT today FROM t) - 90 AS chain_still_invoiced
FROM l JOIN c ON c.customer = l.customer LEFT JOIN h ON h.customer_chain = l.customer_chain
WHERE c.last_invoiced <= (SELECT today FROM t) - 90
GROUP BY l.customer, l.customer_chain, l.currency, c.last_invoiced, h.chain_last
ORDER BY revenue_in_the_year_before DESC NULLS LAST, l.customer

insights.title: Customers paying below cost: last 180 days, biggest first
insights.about: Customer and item (one unit, one currency) over the last 180 days where the customer paid under 95% of the cost booked on its own invoice lines (quantity-weighted, posted Sage lines, BC pilot left out). Lines whose cost is more than 5 times their revenue are left out as a wrong unit cost (the Cost looks wrong measure). Under cost is cost less what they paid, in the line's currency, never converted. The same list as Home's Financials, which shows the biggest few.
insights.sql:
WITH t AS (SELECT (now() AT TIME ZONE '{business_tz}')::date AS today),
l AS (SELECT customer_handle AS cust, customer, item_code AS item, coalesce(item_name, item_code) AS item_name, quantity_unit AS unit,
    revenue_currency AS currency, quantity, revenue, margin, margin_basis, invoice_date
  FROM sales_invoice_lines, t WHERE NOT pilot AND customer_handle IS NOT NULL AND coalesce(customer, '') !~* '\m(do\s+not\s+use|don''?t\s+use)\M' AND item_code IS NOT NULL AND quantity > 0
    AND quantity_unit IS NOT NULL AND revenue > 0 AND revenue_currency IS NOT NULL
    AND invoice_date > t.today - 360 AND invoice_date <= t.today),
s AS (SELECT cust, max(customer) AS customer, item, max(item_name) AS item_name, unit, currency,
    sum(quantity) AS quantity, sum(revenue) AS paid, sum(revenue - margin) AS cost, max(invoice_date) AS last_invoice
  FROM l, t WHERE invoice_date > t.today - 180 AND margin_basis IN ('same_currency', 'cost_converted_at_invoice_rate')
    AND NOT (margin < -4 * revenue) GROUP BY cust, item, unit, currency)
SELECT customer || ' · ' || item_name || ' (' || currency || ')' AS customer_and_product, customer, item, item_name, unit, currency, quantity, round(paid, 2) AS paid, round(cost, 2) AS cost,
  round(paid / cost * 100) AS paid_percent_of_cost, round(cost - paid, 2) AS under_cost, last_invoice
FROM s WHERE cost > 0 AND paid < cost * 0.95
ORDER BY currency, cost - paid DESC

insights.title: Prices that dropped: customer's price down 10% or more on the 180 days before
insights.about: Customer and item (one unit, one currency) whose quantity-weighted price over the last 180 days is at least 10% under their price in the 180 days before (posted Sage lines, BC pilot left out). An item its system mostly books at no cost (a service or miscellaneous line) is not judged. Revenue given up is the quantity bought now at the earlier price less what they paid, in the line's currency, never converted. The same list as Home's Financials.
insights.sql:
WITH t AS (SELECT (now() AT TIME ZONE '{business_tz}')::date AS today),
l AS (SELECT customer_handle AS cust, customer, item_code AS item, coalesce(item_name, item_code) AS item_name, quantity_unit AS unit,
    revenue_currency AS currency, quantity, revenue, margin, margin_basis, invoice_date
  FROM sales_invoice_lines, t WHERE NOT pilot AND customer_handle IS NOT NULL AND coalesce(customer, '') !~* '\m(do\s+not\s+use|don''?t\s+use)\M' AND item_code IS NOT NULL AND quantity > 0
    AND quantity_unit IS NOT NULL AND revenue > 0 AND revenue_currency IS NOT NULL
    AND invoice_date > t.today - 360 AND invoice_date <= t.today),
w AS (SELECT cust, max(customer) AS customer, item, max(item_name) AS item_name, unit, currency,
    sum(quantity) FILTER (WHERE invoice_date > t.today - 180) AS q_now, sum(revenue) FILTER (WHERE invoice_date > t.today - 180) AS rev_now,
    sum(quantity) FILTER (WHERE invoice_date <= t.today - 180) AS q_before, sum(revenue) FILTER (WHERE invoice_date <= t.today - 180) AS rev_before,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE margin_basis IN ('same_currency', 'cost_converted_at_invoice_rate') AND revenue - margin > 0) AS costed, count(*) AS lines
  FROM l, t GROUP BY cust, item, unit, currency)
SELECT customer || ' · ' || item_name || ' (' || currency || ')' AS customer_and_product, customer, item, item_name, unit, currency, round(rev_before / q_before, 4) AS price_before, round(rev_now / q_now, 4) AS price_now,
  round((1 - (rev_now / q_now) / (rev_before / q_before)) * 100) AS dropped_percent, round(q_now, 2) AS quantity_now,
  round(q_now * rev_before / q_before - rev_now, 2) AS revenue_given_up
FROM w WHERE q_now > 0 AND q_before > 0 AND (rev_now / q_now) <= (rev_before / q_before) * (1 - 0.10) AND costed * 2 >= lines
ORDER BY currency, revenue_given_up DESC
